resources.string: Choose background displays, cycle them, and add notifications and weather
Ambient keeps useful information on your Glyph display and adapts when music plays or your phone charges.

In Glyph Toys, enable Ambient and tap its play button. Drag it to the top to make it your home toy. For use while locked, open Settings → Initial setup → Always-on Glyph Toy and select “GlyphWorks” in Nothing OS.

Open Ambient settings and toggle the background displays you want. They cycle in the order shown, independently of the main Glyph Toys list. One selection stays fixed; no selections leave a blank background.

With Ambient selected and the menu picker closed, press the Essential Key once on Phone (4a) Pro, or the Glyph Button on Phone (3), to show the next background. While the menu picker is open, a single press still navigates toys. Essential Key double and triple presses keep their usual actions.
Optionally enable “Change automatically every 15 seconds”. It starts off disabled. A manual change restarts the interval; night and shake visibility settings pause it while the background is hidden.

For Notifications, open its setup row and grant notification access. Choose an envelope, “txt”, notification dot, or bell marquee in the Notifications toy settings; Ambient uses the same choice. All styles count outstanding dismissible notifications: 0–9, then 9+ for ten or more. This access is separate from permission for GlyphWorks to post notifications.

For Weather, open its setup row, enable weather, and allow approximate location. Open app permissions and choose “Allow all the time” for Location to follow you while locked. Otherwise it uses your last foreground location. Choose Celsius or Fahrenheit. Open-Meteo supplies the conditions and temperature, which take turns sliding across the display.

Music takes priority over charging, and charging over the background. Automatic cycling pauses during these overlays and starts a fresh interval when the background returns. A single press still changes the background underneath.
